| `action.docker_compose_run` | action | Runs a one-off container for a compose service, like `docker compose run`: the container `<project>-<service>-run-<id>` is created from the service's compose model (image pulled or built, networks, volumes, secrets and configs as for `docker_compose`), labelled `com.docker.compose.oneoff=True`, waited for and removed. | [reference/action.docker_compose_run.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_compose_run.md) | [actions/compose_run.md](docs/actions/compose_run.md) |
| `action.docker_compose_scale` | action | Sets the number of containers of compose services on the provider's daemon, like `docker compose scale web=3`: missing `<project>-<service>-<n>` containers are created from the compose model (pulled or built as needed) and the highest-numbered extra ones are removed; kept containers that are stopped are started. | [reference/action.docker_compose_scale.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_compose_scale.md) | [actions/compose_scale.md](docs/actions/compose_scale.md) |
| `action.docker_compose_start` | action | Starts the existing stopped containers of a compose project, like `docker compose start`. | [reference/action.docker_compose_start.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_compose_start.md) | [actions/compose_start.md](docs/actions/compose_start.md) |
| `action.docker_compose_stop` | action | Stops the running containers of a compose project without removing them, like `docker compose stop`. | [reference/action.docker_compose_stop.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_compose_stop.md) | [actions/compose_stop.md](docs/actions/compose_stop.md) |
| `action.docker_compose_unpause` | action | Unpauses the paused containers of a compose project, like `docker compose unpause`. | [reference/action.docker_compose_unpause.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_compose_unpause.md) | [actions/compose_unpause.md](docs/actions/compose_unpause.md) |
| `action.docker_compose_wait` | action | Blocks until the containers of compose services stop, like `docker compose wait`. | [reference/action.docker_compose_wait.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_compose_wait.md) | [actions/compose_wait.md](docs/actions/compose_wait.md) |
| `action.docker_container_cp` | action | Copies a file or directory into an existing container at any time, like `docker container cp SRC CONTAINER:PATH`. | [reference/action.docker_container_cp.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_cp.md) | [actions/container_cp.md](docs/actions/container_cp.md) |
| `action.docker_container_export` | action | Writes a container's filesystem to a local tar file, like `docker container export --output`. | [reference/action.docker_container_export.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_export.md) | [actions/container_export.md](docs/actions/container_export.md) |
| `action.docker_container_kill` | action | Sends a signal to a running container, like `docker container kill`. | [reference/action.docker_container_kill.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_kill.md) | [actions/container_kill.md](docs/actions/container_kill.md) |
| `action.docker_container_pause` | action | Freezes all processes of a running container, like `docker container pause` (the cgroup freezer). | [reference/action.docker_container_pause.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_pause.md) | [actions/container_pause.md](docs/actions/container_pause.md) |
| `action.docker_container_prune` | action | Removes stopped containers, like `docker container prune`, and reports what it removed and the space reclaimed. | [reference/action.docker_container_prune.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_prune.md) | [actions/container_prune.md](docs/actions/container_prune.md) |
| `action.docker_container_restart` | action | Restarts a container, like `docker container restart`: a stop (signal, grace period, SIGKILL) followed by a start. | [reference/action.docker_container_restart.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_restart.md) | [actions/container_restart.md](docs/actions/container_restart.md) |
| `action.docker_container_start` | action | Starts a stopped or created container, like `docker container start`. | [reference/action.docker_container_start.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_start.md) | [actions/container_start.md](docs/actions/container_start.md) |
| `action.docker_container_stop` | action | Stops a running container, like `docker container stop`: it sends the stop signal, waits for the grace period and then sends SIGKILL. | [reference/action.docker_container_stop.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_stop.md) | [actions/container_stop.md](docs/actions/container_stop.md) |
| `action.docker_container_unpause` | action | Resumes the processes of a paused container, like `docker container unpause`. | [reference/action.docker_container_unpause.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_unpause.md) | [actions/container_unpause.md](docs/actions/container_unpause.md) |
| `action.docker_container_wait` | action | Blocks until a container reaches a condition and reports its exit code, like `docker container wait`. | [reference/action.docker_container_wait.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_container_wait.md) | [actions/container_wait.md](docs/actions/container_wait.md) |
| `action.docker_exec` | action | Runs a command inside a running container, like `docker exec`, and fails when it exits non-zero. | [reference/action.docker_exec.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_exec.md) | [actions/exec.md](docs/actions/exec.md) |
| `action.docker_network_prune` | action | Removes networks no container uses, like `docker network prune`, and reports what it removed. | [reference/action.docker_network_prune.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_network_prune.md) | [actions/network_prune.md](docs/actions/network_prune.md) |
| `action.docker_plugin_create` | action | Creates a local plugin from a host directory holding `config.json` and a `rootfs/` directory, like `docker plugin create` (`POST /plugins/create`). | [reference/action.docker_plugin_create.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_plugin_create.md) | [actions/plugin_create.md](docs/actions/plugin_create.md) |
| `action.docker_plugin_push` | action | Pushes a local plugin to its registry, like `docker plugin push` (`POST /plugins/{name}/push`), using the provider's `registry_auth` credentials for the plugin's registry. | [reference/action.docker_plugin_push.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_plugin_push.md) | [actions/plugin_push.md](docs/actions/plugin_push.md) |
| `action.docker_system_prune` | action | Removes unused Docker objects, like `docker system prune`, and reports what it removed and the space reclaimed. | [reference/action.docker_system_prune.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_system_prune.md) | [actions/system_prune.md](docs/actions/system_prune.md) |
| `action.docker_volume_prune` | action | Removes volumes no container uses (anonymous ones only, unless `all = true`), like `docker volume prune`, and reports what it removed and the space reclaimed. | [reference/action.docker_volume_prune.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_volume_prune.md) | [actions/volume_prune.md](docs/actions/volume_prune.md) |
| `ephemeral.docker_exec_output` | ephemeral resource | Runs a command in a running container (`docker exec`) and returns its standard output and error as ephemeral values that are never written to plan or state. | [reference/ephemeral.docker_exec_output.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/ephemeral.docker_exec_output.md) | [ephemeral-resources/exec_output.md](docs/ephemeral-resources/exec_output.md) |
| `list.docker_container` | list resource | Lists containers on the provider's Docker host as `docker_container` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import. | [reference/list.docker_container.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_container.md) | [list-resources/container.md](docs/list-resources/container.md) |
| `list.docker_network` | list resource | Lists networks on the provider's Docker host as `docker_network` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import. | [reference/list.docker_network.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_network.md) | [list-resources/network.md](docs/list-resources/network.md) |
| `list.docker_volume` | list resource | Lists volumes on the provider's Docker host as `docker_volume` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import. | [reference/list.docker_volume.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_volume.md) | [list-resources/volume.md](docs/list-resources/volume.md) |

## 3. Swarm topology

Turn the provider's daemon into a Swarm manager and join further hosts as workers or managers.

| Type | Kind | Description | Skill reference | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docker_node` | resource | Manages the labels, availability and role of a swarm node that has already joined, like `docker node update`, through the provider's Docker host (which must be a manager). | [reference/docker_node.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_node.md) | [resources/node.md](docs/resources/node.md) |
| `docker_swarm_init` | resource | Initializes a Docker Swarm on the provider's Docker host (`docker swarm init` through the Engine API), making that daemon the first manager. | [reference/docker_swarm_init.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_swarm_init.md) | [resources/swarm_init.md](docs/resources/swarm_init.md) |
| `docker_swarm_node` | resource | Joins a Docker host to an existing swarm (`docker swarm join`); to manage a node that already joined without joining or leaving, use `docker_node`. | [reference/docker_swarm_node.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_swarm_node.md) | [resources/swarm_node.md](docs/resources/swarm_node.md) |
| `data.docker_node` | data source | Looks up one swarm node (`GET /nodes/{id}`) through the provider's Docker host (which must be a manager), by `id` (full ID or unique prefix) or `hostname`. | [reference/data.docker_node.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_node.md) | [data-sources/node.md](docs/data-sources/node.md) |
| `data.docker_nodes` | data source | Lists the swarm's nodes (`GET /nodes`) through the provider's Docker host (which must be a manager), sorted by name (the node name, else its hostname) then ID. | [reference/data.docker_nodes.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_nodes.md) | [data-sources/nodes.md](docs/data-sources/nodes.md) |
| `data.docker_swarm` | data source | Reads the swarm the provider's Docker host manages (`GET /swarm`): ID, spec, join tokens, root CA and data path port. | [reference/data.docker_swarm.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_swarm.md) | [data-sources/swarm.md](docs/data-sources/swarm.md) |
| `data.docker_swarm_tokens` | data source | Reads the join tokens of the swarm the provider's Docker host manages (SwarmInspect), as `worker` / `manager` and the structured `join_tokens`. | [reference/data.docker_swarm_tokens.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_swarm_tokens.md) | [data-sources/swarm_tokens.md](docs/data-sources/swarm_tokens.md) |
| `action.docker_node_activate` | action | Sets a swarm node's availability back to `active`, like `docker node update --availability active`. | [reference/action.docker_node_activate.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_node_activate.md) | [actions/node_activate.md](docs/actions/node_activate.md) |
| `action.docker_node_demote` | action | Demotes a swarm manager to worker, like `docker node demote` (NodeUpdate with `Role = worker`). | [reference/action.docker_node_demote.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_node_demote.md) | [actions/node_demote.md](docs/actions/node_demote.md) |
| `action.docker_node_drain` | action | Sets a swarm node's availability to `drain` and waits until its tasks have left, like `docker node update --availability drain`. | [reference/action.docker_node_drain.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_node_drain.md) | [actions/node_drain.md](docs/actions/node_drain.md) |
| `action.docker_node_promote` | action | Promotes a swarm worker to manager, like `docker node promote` (NodeUpdate with `Role = manager`). | [reference/action.docker_node_promote.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_node_promote.md) | [actions/node_promote.md](docs/actions/node_promote.md) |
| `action.docker_swarm_rotate_ca` | action | Rotates the swarm root CA, like `docker swarm ca --rotate`: a new self-signed root, or the given signing certificate and key (`Spec.CAConfig.SigningCACert` / `SigningCAKey`), with `CAConfig.ForceRotate` incremented. | [reference/action.docker_swarm_rotate_ca.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_swarm_rotate_ca.md) | [actions/swarm_rotate_ca.md](docs/actions/swarm_rotate_ca.md) |
| `action.docker_swarm_rotate_tokens` | action | Rotates the swarm join tokens, like `docker swarm join-token --rotate`. | [reference/action.docker_swarm_rotate_tokens.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_swarm_rotate_tokens.md) | [actions/swarm_rotate_tokens.md](docs/actions/swarm_rotate_tokens.md) |
| `action.docker_swarm_rotate_unlock_key` | action | Rotates the manager unlock key of an autolocked swarm, like `docker swarm unlock-key --rotate`. | [reference/action.docker_swarm_rotate_unlock_key.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_swarm_rotate_unlock_key.md) | [actions/swarm_rotate_unlock_key.md](docs/actions/swarm_rotate_unlock_key.md) |
| `action.docker_swarm_unlock` | action | Unlocks a locked swarm manager, like `docker swarm unlock`: after a daemon restart, a manager of an autolocked swarm stays locked until it gets the unlock key. | [reference/action.docker_swarm_unlock.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_swarm_unlock.md) | [actions/swarm_unlock.md](docs/actions/swarm_unlock.md) |
| `ephemeral.docker_swarm_tokens` | ephemeral resource | Reads the worker and manager join tokens of the swarm the provider's Docker host manages, as ephemeral values that are never written to plan or state. | [reference/ephemeral.docker_swarm_tokens.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/ephemeral.docker_swarm_tokens.md) | [ephemeral-resources/swarm_tokens.md](docs/ephemeral-resources/swarm_tokens.md) |
| `list.docker_swarm_node` | list resource | Lists the swarm's nodes as `docker_swarm_node` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/list.docker_swarm_node.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_swarm_node.md) | [list-resources/swarm_node.md](docs/list-resources/swarm_node.md) |

## 4. Swarm workload

Secrets, configs, services and stacks scheduled by the Swarm. Needs layer 3.

| Type | Kind | Description | Skill reference | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docker_config` | resource | A Swarm config: a non-secret blob mounted into service tasks as a file. | [reference/docker_config.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_config.md) | [resources/config.md](docs/resources/config.md) |
| `docker_secret` | resource | A Swarm secret: a blob the Swarm managers store encrypted and mount into service tasks under `/run/secrets/<file_name>`. | [reference/docker_secret.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_secret.md) | [resources/secret.md](docs/resources/secret.md) |
| `docker_service` | resource | A Swarm service: a desired number of tasks (containers) of one image scheduled across the Swarm. | [reference/docker_service.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_service.md) | [resources/service.md](docs/resources/service.md) |
| `docker_stack` | resource | A Swarm stack built from API primitives (not a compose file, no CLI): services, overlay networks, secrets and configs, each named `<stack>_<name>` and labelled `com.docker.stack.namespace=<stack>` so `docker stack ls/ps` show them. | [reference/docker_stack.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_stack.md) | [resources/stack.md](docs/resources/stack.md) |
| `data.docker_config` | data source | Looks up one swarm config (`GET /configs/{id}`) by `id` or `name`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/data.docker_config.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_config.md) | [data-sources/config.md](docs/data-sources/config.md) |
| `data.docker_configs` | data source | Lists the swarm's configs (`GET /configs`), sorted by name, with their content (`configs[*].spec.data`, base64); the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/data.docker_configs.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_configs.md) | [data-sources/configs.md](docs/data-sources/configs.md) |
| `data.docker_secret` | data source | Looks up one swarm secret's metadata (`GET /secrets/{id}`) by `id` or `name`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/data.docker_secret.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_secret.md) | [data-sources/secret.md](docs/data-sources/secret.md) |
| `data.docker_secrets` | data source | Lists the swarm's secrets (`GET /secrets`), sorted by name; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/data.docker_secrets.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_secrets.md) | [data-sources/secrets.md](docs/data-sources/secrets.md) |
| `data.docker_service` | data source | Looks up one swarm service (`GET /services/{id}`) by `id` or `name`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/data.docker_service.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_service.md) | [data-sources/service.md](docs/data-sources/service.md) |
| `data.docker_service_logs` | data source | Reads a snapshot of a swarm service's logs, aggregated over its tasks (`GET /services/{id}/logs`), like `docker service logs`. | [reference/data.docker_service_logs.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_service_logs.md) | [data-sources/service_logs.md](docs/data-sources/service_logs.md) |
| `data.docker_services` | data source | Lists the swarm's services (`GET /services`), sorted by name; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/data.docker_services.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_services.md) | [data-sources/services.md](docs/data-sources/services.md) |
| `data.docker_stack` | data source | Reads the services of one Swarm stack, like `docker stack services`: mode, `running/desired` replicas, image and published ports per service. | [reference/data.docker_stack.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_stack.md) | [data-sources/stack.md](docs/data-sources/stack.md) |
| `data.docker_stacks` | data source | Lists the Swarm stacks, like `docker stack ls`: services grouped by the `com.docker.stack.namespace` label, with the number of services in each (`services_count`). | [reference/data.docker_stacks.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_stacks.md) | [data-sources/stacks.md](docs/data-sources/stacks.md) |
| `data.docker_task` | data source | Looks up one swarm task (`GET /tasks/{id}`) by `id`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/data.docker_task.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_task.md) | [data-sources/task.md](docs/data-sources/task.md) |
| `data.docker_task_logs` | data source | Reads a snapshot of one swarm task's logs (`GET /tasks/{id}/logs`), like `docker service logs <task id>`. | [reference/data.docker_task_logs.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_task_logs.md) | [data-sources/task_logs.md](docs/data-sources/task_logs.md) |
| `data.docker_tasks` | data source | Lists swarm tasks (`GET /tasks`), like `docker service ps`, `docker node ps` and `docker stack ps`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/data.docker_tasks.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_tasks.md) | [data-sources/tasks.md](docs/data-sources/tasks.md) |
| `action.docker_service_force_update` | action | Redeploys every task of a swarm service without changing its spec, like `docker service update --force`. | [reference/action.docker_service_force_update.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_service_force_update.md) | [actions/service_force_update.md](docs/actions/service_force_update.md) |
| `action.docker_service_rollback` | action | Rolls a swarm service back to its previous spec, like `docker service rollback`, and waits for the rollback to complete. | [reference/action.docker_service_rollback.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_service_rollback.md) | [actions/service_rollback.md](docs/actions/service_rollback.md) |
| `action.docker_service_scale` | action | Sets the replica count of a replicated swarm service, like `docker service scale`, and waits for the tasks. | [reference/action.docker_service_scale.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_service_scale.md) | [actions/service_scale.md](docs/actions/service_scale.md) |
| `list.docker_config` | list resource | Lists swarm configs as `docker_config` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/list.docker_config.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_config.md) | [list-resources/config.md](docs/list-resources/config.md) |
| `list.docker_secret` | list resource | Lists swarm secrets as `docker_secret` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/list.docker_secret.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_secret.md) | [list-resources/secret.md](docs/list-resources/secret.md) |
| `list.docker_service` | list resource | Lists swarm services as `docker_service` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/list.docker_service.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_service.md) | [list-resources/service.md](docs/list-resources/service.md) |
